description: NaPb₂Mn₂V₃O₁₂ is Esseneite-derived structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal I4₁/acd space group. Na is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.58 Å) and four longer (2.75 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 45°. There are two shorter (1.75 Å) and two longer (1.76 Å) V-O bond lengths. In the second V site, V is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 45°. All V-O bond lengths are 1.76 Å. Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with six VO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (2.18 Å) and four longer (2.20 Å) Mn-O bond lengths. Pb is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Pb-O bond distances ranging from 2.56-2.74 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one V, one Mn, and two equivalent Pb atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, one Mn, and one Pb atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, one Mn, and one Pb atom.
